## FM27 Tactical Bible 4.13.4

- **Copy set-piece state** now switches FM to each set-piece tab itself (corners, free kicks, throw-ins), reads each twice to skip FM's placeholder data, flags empty tabs, and restores the tab you had open.

### Installation
Download `…setup.exe` (installer) or `FM27-Tactical-Bible-portatil.exe` (runs without installing).
